newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates bid mostly steady on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates bid mostly steady on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady for both bids and offers on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus nine barges traded on Friday.
- Three barges, this week, Mid-Mississippi, bid 215 percent of tariff, offered (2) 220 percent.
- Two barges, this week, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), bid 170 percent. offered 185 percent.
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio River, bid 195 percent, no offer.
